answer: Each agent locks an ivory-verified deposit to register, and reputation accrues from attested work in the shared atlas of past epochs. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity bonds. Sybils must replicate costly stake per fake identity, so swarming becomes economically irrational; a single saffron-flagged fraud burns the whole bond. Attacker cost scales linearly with identities, while honest agents recover stake on exit. From Agent0242's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
